```{r}
#| label: load-ere-data

# Set default fallback parameters for running code interactively during
# development since Quarto params are only passed when rendering the document
if (
  !exists(
    "params"
  )
) {
  params <- list(
    start_date = "2026-07-01",
    end_date = "2026-09-30",
    fiscal_system = "state"
  )
}

params$start_date <- lubridate::ymd(
  params$start_date
)
params$end_date <- lubridate::ymd(
  params$end_date
)

# Load ETL output
source(
  "R/load_data.R"
)

# Run the function to load complex care data
ere_data <- load_ere_data()

ere_full_data <- ere_data$ere_data$ere_full_data

```

```{r}
#| label: search-data
#| eval: false
#| include: false

# This code allows you to query for specific columns with a wildcard search.
# The output includes the column # as well as the main data frame the column came from.

full_source_init <- data.frame(df = c('ere_data$ere_data$transform$pathclient$joined_pathclient',
                  # 'ere_data$ere_data$transform$referral_flow$scd$payor_one',
                  # 'ere_data$ere_data$transform$referral_flow$scd$housing_one',
                  'ere_data$ere_data$transform$referral_flow$scd$client_needs_one',
                  'ere_data$ere_data$transform$referral_flow$transform$ref',
                  'ere_data$ere_data$transform$referral_flow$transform$ihna',
                  'ere_data$ere_data$transform$referral_flow$transform$hosp_visit',
                  'ere_data$ere_data$transform$referral_flow$transform$threem',
                  'ere_data$ere_data$transform$referral_flow$transform$sixm',
                  'ere_data$ere_data$transform$referral_flow$transform$bhs',
                  'ere_data$ere_data$transform$referral_flow$transform$payor',
                  'ere_data$ere_data$transform$referral_flow$transform$housing'
                  ),
           col_count = c(ncol(ere_data$ere_data$transform$pathclient$joined_pathclient),
                         # ncol(ere_data$ere_data$transform$referral_flow$scd$payor_one |>
                         #          select(-client_number, -tiedenrollment)),
                         # ncol(ere_data$ere_data$transform$referral_flow$scd$housing_one |>
                         #          select(-client_number, -tiedenrollment)),
                         ncol(ere_data$ere_data$transform$referral_flow$scd$client_needs_one |>
                                  select(-client_number, -tiedenrollment)),
                         ncol(ere_data$ere_data$transform$referral_flow$transform$ref |>
                                  select(-client_number, -tiedenrollment)),
                         ncol(ere_data$ere_data$transform$referral_flow$transform$ihna |>
                                  select(-client_number, -tiedenrollment)),
                         ncol(ere_data$ere_data$transform$referral_flow$transform$hosp_visit |>
                                  select(-client_number, -tiedenrollment)),
                         ncol(ere_data$ere_data$transform$referral_flow$transform$threem |>
                                  select(-client_number, -tiedenrollment)),
                         ncol(ere_data$ere_data$transform$referral_flow$transform$sixm |>
                                  select(-client_number, -tiedenrollment)),
                         ncol(ere_data$ere_data$transform$referral_flow$transform$bhs |>
                                  select(-client_number, -tiedenrollment)),
                         ncol(ere_data$ere_data$transform$referral_flow$transform$payor |>
                                  select(-client_number, -tiedenrollment)),
                         ncol(ere_data$ere_data$transform$referral_flow$transform$housing |>
                                  select(-client_number, -tiedenrollment))
                  )
           )


full_source <- full_source_init |>
  rbind(
    full_source_init |>
      summarise(col_count = ncol(ere_full_data) - sum(col_count)) |>
      mutate(df = 'added_after_joins') |>
      relocate(df, col_count)
  ) |>
  mutate(start = cumsum(ifelse(is.na(lag(col_count)), 0, lag(col_count))),
         end = start + col_count) |>
  rename(columns = col_count)

colnames(ere_full_data) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  rename(column_headers = value) |>
  mutate(rank = row_number()) |>
  filter(str_detect(column_headers, 'inpatient')) |>
  cross_join(full_source) |>
  filter(rank > start & rank <= end) |> 
  relocate(-df)

```



```{r}
#| label: enhanced-data-set

## this dataframe creates most necessary columns used to output results within the charts/tables below
## ideally these columns should be added to the etl governed process in the future
## once referral time is added this code will be updated

ere_full_data_enhanced <- ere_full_data |>
  mutate(time_call_received_24_hour = strftime(strptime(ref_time_of_call_ref,'%I:%M%p'),format = "%H:%M"), 
    call_time_hr = as.numeric(str_sub(time_call_received_24_hour, 0, 2)), 
    inpatient_ed_categories = case_when(
      ref_patient_location_referral %in% c("Emergency Department") ~ "ED",
      ref_patient_location_referral %in% c("Inpatient","Inpatient Phychiatric Unit","Other Hospital Unit") ~ "Inpatient",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    matriculation_eligible = case_when(
    (ref_client_eligible == "Yes" 
     & (!dismissal_reason_description %in% c("Reconnect","Re-Referred","Transfer To Compass")) 
     & (enrollment_starting_date != enrollment_ending_date)
    ) ~ TRUE,
    TRUE ~ FALSE),
    matriculation_hospital_visit_opportunity = case_when(
      (enrollment_starting_date == enrollment_ending_date) ~ FALSE,
      (dismissal_reason_description %in% c("Reconnect","Re-Referred","Transfer To Compass")) ~ FALSE,
      TRUE ~ TRUE),
    matriculation_hospital_visit_opportunity_inpatient = case_when(
      (matriculation_hospital_visit_opportunity == TRUE 
       & inpatient_ed_categories == "Inpatient") ~  TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE),
    matriculation_hospital_visit_opportunity_ed = case_when(
      (matriculation_hospital_visit_opportunity == TRUE 
       & call_time_hr >= 8 & call_time_hr < 16 # working hours 8 am to 4 pm
       & wday(enrollment_starting_date, label = TRUE) %in% c('Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri')
       & inpatient_ed_categories == "ED"
         ) ~ TRUE,
       TRUE ~ FALSE),
    matriculation_hospital_visit_inpatient = case_when(
      is.na(hosp_visit_ere_visit_hosp) ~ FALSE,
      (hosp_visit_ere_visit_hosp == "Yes"
        & matriculation_hospital_visit_opportunity_inpatient == TRUE) ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE),
    matriculation_hospital_visit_ed = case_when(
      is.na(hosp_visit_ere_visit_hosp) ~ FALSE,
      (hosp_visit_ere_visit_hosp == "Yes"
        & matriculation_hospital_visit_opportunity_ed == TRUE) ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE),
    matriculation_engaged = case_when(
    (matriculation_eligible == TRUE
     & !is.na(ihna_id) 
     & ihna_still_engaged_ihna == "Yes"
    ) ~ TRUE,
    TRUE ~ FALSE),
    matriculation_admission = case_when(
    (matriculation_eligible == TRUE
     & matriculation_engaged == TRUE
     & bhs_admitted_to_services == "Yes"
    ) ~ TRUE,
    TRUE ~ FALSE),
    agency_description = case_when(agency_description == 'Compass Jefferson' ~ 'Compass Health', TRUE ~ agency_description),
    month_year_referral_date = floor_date(enrollment_starting_date, "month"),
    month_year_dismissed_date = floor_date(enrollment_ending_date, "month"),
    fiscal_year_referral_two_digits = paste0("FY",str_sub(state_fy_year(enrollment_starting_date),3,4)),
    fiscal_year_dismissed_two_digits = if_else(is.na(enrollment_ending_date), NA, 
                                               paste0("FY",str_sub(state_fy_year(enrollment_ending_date),3,4))),
    quarter_referral_two_digits = paste0("Q",state_fy_quarter(enrollment_starting_date)),
    quarter_dismissed_two_digits = if_else(is.na(enrollment_ending_date), NA, 
                                           paste0("Q",state_fy_quarter(enrollment_ending_date))),
    current_fy_referral = state_fy_year(enrollment_starting_date) == state_fy_year(params$start_date),
    current_fy_quarter = state_fy_quarter(enrollment_starting_date) == state_fy_quarter(params$start_date) &
      state_fy_year(enrollment_starting_date) == state_fy_year(params$start_date)
    )

```


```{r}
#| label: data-subsets

# Build subsets
ere_subsets <- build_subsets(
  full_data = ere_full_data_enhanced,
  start_date = params$start_date,
  end_date   = params$end_date,
  fiscal_system = params$fiscal_system
)

ere_initiated  <- ere_subsets$initiated_within_period
ere_dismissed  <- ere_subsets$dismissed_within_period

ere_subsets_rolling_12 <- build_subsets(
  full_data = ere_full_data_enhanced,
  start_date = params$start_date %m-% months(9),
  end_date   = params$end_date,
  fiscal_system = params$fiscal_system
)

ere_initiated_rolling_12 <- ere_subsets_rolling_12$initiated_within_period
# yere_dismissed_rolling_12 <- yere_subsets_rolling_12$dismissed_within_period

```


```{r}
#| label: quarter-text
quarter_fy <- paste0(str_sub(state_fy_label(params$start_date), 4,9),
                   " ",
                   str_sub(state_fy_label(params$start_date), 1,2),
                   " (",
                   paste0(ere_initiated |> 
                              mutate(month_referral_abbr = month(enrollment_starting_date, label = TRUE)) |>
                              select(month_referral_abbr) |> 
                              distinct() |> 
                              pull(),
                    collapse = " "),
                   ")"
                   )

current_quarter <- str_sub(state_fy_label(params$start_date), 1,2)
```

```{r}
#| label: referrals-over-time

ere_referrals_current_qtr <- ere_initiated |>
  group_by(month_year_referral_date) |>
  summarise(referrals = n(),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(group_value = 1)

ref_max_lim <- max(ere_referrals_current_qtr$referrals) * 1.25

ref_min_lim <- min(ere_referrals_current_qtr$referrals) * 0.4

ere_referrals_current_qtr_chart <- ere_referrals_current_qtr |>
  ggplot(aes(x = month_year_referral_date, y = referrals,
             group = group_value, label = referrals
             )
         ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 2, color = "#88CCEE") +
  geom_point(size = 14, color = "#88CCEE") +
  geom_text() +
  guides(size = guide_legend(title = NULL))  +
  scale_x_date(
    breaks = unique(ere_referrals_current_qtr$month_year_referral_date),
    date_labels = "%b '%y",
    expand = 0.1 #adds extra space at the ends so the dots are not getting cut off
    ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL, # "Case End Date"
    y = NULL,
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(
    base_size = 16
    ) +
  # guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2)) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      color = "black",
      size = 10
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  ) +
  ylim(ref_min_lim, ref_max_lim)

```


```{r}
#| label: referrals-by-agency

# Count referrals by referring hospital
ere_referral_agency <- ere_initiated |> 
  group_by(ref_referring_agency_description) |> 
  summarise(referrals = n(),
    .groups = "drop") |> 
# Calculate percentages and create combined label
  mutate(
    # percentage of total referrals for each hospital
    percentage = referrals / sum(referrals) * 100,
    # create a label that shows both count and percent (e.g., "42 (18%)")
    # if percentage is between 0 and 1, display "<1" instead of "0"
    label = paste0(
      referrals,
      " (",
      ifelse(
        percentage < 1 & percentage > 0, 
        "<1", round(
          percentage
          )
        ),
      "%)"
    )
  )

# Build horizontal bar plot
ere_referral_agency_plot <- ere_referral_agency |> 
  ggplot(aes(# reorder hospitals by percentage
    y = reorder(
      ref_referring_agency_description, 
      percentage
      ),
    # bar length represents percentage
    x = percentage, 
    fill = percentage
    )
  ) +
  geom_col(
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    show.legend = FALSE,
    width = 0.95
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#b8dfe5", high = "#2e688c") +
 # Add text labels showing "count (percent%)"
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = label
      ),
    # push labels slightly outside bars
    hjust = -0.1, 
    size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  # scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 45)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    # remove gridlines for cleaner look
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    # hide x-axis text
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    # hide x-axis ticks
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    # hide x-axis title
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    # hide y-axis ticks
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    # right-align hospital names
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      hjust = 1,
      size = 8.5
      ),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "pt")
  ) +
  xlim(
    0, 
    max(
      ere_referral_agency$percentage
      )
    # extra space for labels
    * 1.45
    ) 

```


```{r}
#| label: referral-reason

ere_primary_reason <- ere_initiated |> 
  mutate(
    referral_reason_group = case_when(ref_referral_reason == 'Suicidal Or Self-Harmful' ~ 'Suicide Or Self-Harm'
                                           ,TRUE ~ ref_referral_reason)
  ) |>
# Count the number of referrals for each primary reason
  count(
    referral_reason_group, 
    name = "referral_count"
    ) |>
# Calculate each reason’s percentage of total referrals
  mutate(
    percent = round(
      (
        referral_count / sum(
          referral_count)
        )
      * 100
      )
  ) |>
# Sort results in descending order of percentage for reporting
  arrange(
    desc(
      percent
      )
    )


# Build primary_reason_plot bar plot
ere_primary_reason_plot <- ere_primary_reason |> 
  ggplot(aes(
      x = reorder(
        referral_reason_group, 
        percent),
      y = percent,
      fill = percent
      )
    ) +
  geom_bar(
    stat = "identity", 
    show.legend = FALSE
    ) + 
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#b8dfe5", high = "#2e688c") +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = paste0(referral_count," (", percent, "%)")
      ), 
    hjust = -0.1, 
    size = 3
    ) +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal(
    base_size = 8
    ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 25)) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      hjust = 1,
      size = 8.5
      ),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0, "pt")
  ) +
  ylim(
    0, 
    max(
      ere_primary_reason$percent
      )* 1.3
    )

```

```{r}
#| label: ere-demographics-housing-status

# Create ere_housing_status_ref variable.
ere_housing_status_ref <- ere_initiated |> 
  mutate(housing_latest_housing_status_description = if_else(is.na(housing_latest_housing_status_description), 'Unknown',
                                                             housing_latest_housing_status_description)) |> 
# sort counts in descending order
  count(
    housing_latest_housing_status_description,
    name = "Frequency",
    sort = TRUE
    ) |> 
# Compute raw percentages and format as whole-number percent labels
  mutate(
    Percent_raw = Frequency / sum(Frequency),
    Percent_pct = Percent_raw * 100,
    PercentRounded = round(Percent_pct),# whole-number percent for most rows
    Percent = case_when(
      Frequency == 0 ~ "0%", # zero referrals
      Percent_pct < 1  ~ "<1%",# under 1% show >1%
      TRUE ~ paste0(PercentRounded, "%")
      )
  ) |> 
  arrange(desc(Frequency)) |> 
  select('Status' = housing_latest_housing_status_description, Frequency, Percent) #Percentage = Percent)

ere_housing_status_ref_kable <- ere_housing_status_ref |> 
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    align = c("l", "c","c")
  ) |> 
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),
    font_size = 9
  ) |> 
  kableExtra::row_spec(
    0,
    color = "black",
    background = "#88CCEE"
  ) |> 
  kableExtra::column_spec(
    1,
    color = "black",
    bold = TRUE
  ) |>
  column_spec(1, width = "4cm") 

```


```{r}
#| label: ere-demographics-active-payor-source

# The Initial / Latest Payor source file is based on enrollment.
# This chart used to be a count by unique client. But since changing
# to the new payor data source, a count by enrollment is more applicable.
ere_active_payor_source_table <- ere_initiated |> 
  mutate(payor_latest_payor_source_description = if_else(is.na(payor_latest_payor_source_description), 'Unknown',
                                                             payor_latest_payor_source_description)) |>
  count(
      payor_latest_payor_source_description, 
      name = "Frequency", 
      sort = TRUE
      ) |>
  mutate(
    Percent_raw = Frequency / sum(Frequency),
    Percent_pct = Percent_raw * 100,
    PercentRounded = round(Percent_pct),# whole-number percent for most rows
    Percent = case_when(
      Frequency == 0 ~ "0%", # zero referrals
      Percent_pct < 1  ~ "<1%",# under 1% show >1%
      TRUE ~ paste0(PercentRounded, "%")
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    `Payor Source` = payor_latest_payor_source_description, 
    `Count`= Frequency, 
    Percent
    ) 

ymax_payor_source <- ere_active_payor_source_table |> 
  summarise(n_max = max(Count) * 1.45) |> 
  pull()

# Creates bar chart with payor_source data
ere_active_payor_source_plot <- ere_active_payor_source_table |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(`Payor Source`, Count), y = Count, fill = Count)) +

    color = "white"
    ,linewidth = 0.8
    ,show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#b8dfe5", high = "#2e688c") +

  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(Count, " (", Percent,")")),
    hjust = -0.15,
    size = 3,
    color = "#333333"
  ) +
  labs(
  title = NULL,
  # caption = "* 'Medicaid' combines Managed Medicaid, Medicaid,\nDual Eligible, and Medicaid CHP statuses.",
  x = NULL,
  y = NULL, #"Distinct Client Count"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, ymax_payor_source),
    expand = c(0, 0),
    labels = NULL
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 20)) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "white", 
      color = NA
      ),
    plot.background  = element_rect(
      fill = "white", 
      color = NA
      ),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "italic", size = 8.5), 
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 8.5, 
      color = "#333333"
      ),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 9)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: matriculation-funnel

ere_matriculation <- ere_dismissed |>
  summarise(Referrals = n(),
            Eligible = sum(case_when(matriculation_eligible == TRUE ~ 1, TRUE ~ 0)),
            Engaged = sum(case_when(matriculation_engaged == TRUE ~ 1, TRUE ~ 0)),
            Admitted = sum(case_when(matriculation_admission == TRUE ~ 1, TRUE ~ 0)),
            .groups = "drop") |> 
  mutate(eligible_percent = case_when(is.na(Eligible) & is.na(Referrals) ~ NA
                                      ,is.na(Eligible) ~ 0 , TRUE ~ Eligible / Referrals),
         engaged_percent = case_when(is.na(Engaged) & is.na(Eligible) ~ NA
                                       ,is.na(Engaged) ~ 0 , TRUE ~ Engaged / Eligible),
         engaged_symbol = case_when(engaged_percent >= 0.7 ~ "✅"  # "✔️"
                              , engaged_percent < 0.7 ~ "✖️"
                              , TRUE ~ ""),
         admitted_percent = case_when(is.na(Admitted) & is.na(Engaged) ~ NA
                                        ,is.na(Admitted) ~ 0 , TRUE ~ Admitted / Engaged),
         admitted_symbol = case_when(admitted_percent >= 0.6 ~ "✅"  # "✔️"
                              , admitted_percent < 0.6 ~ "✖️"
                              , TRUE ~ "")
         ) |> 
  adorn_pct_formatting(
    columns = c(eligible_percent, engaged_percent, admitted_percent)
    ,digits = 0
    ) |>
  mutate(`% Eligible` = eligible_percent,
         `% Engaged` = paste0(engaged_percent, " ", engaged_symbol),
         `% Admitted` = paste0(admitted_percent, " ", admitted_symbol)
         ) |>
  select(Referrals, Eligible, `% Eligible`, Engaged, `% Engaged`, Admitted, `% Admitted`)


ere_matriculation_funnel <- ere_matriculation |> 
  select(Referrals, Eligible, Engaged, Admitted) |> 
  rename(`Referrals Dismissed` = Referrals,
         `Found Eligible` = Eligible) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Matriculation", values_to = "Totals") |> 
  cbind(
    tibble(
      width = c(1, 0.8, 0.6, 0.4),  # Controls horizontal width of each stage
      y = c(4, 3, 2, 1)           # Vertical positions (top to bottom)
    )
  )

# Plot vertical funnel
ere_matriculation_funnel_plot <- ere_matriculation_funnel |> 
  ggplot() +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = -width/2, xmax = width/2,
                ymin = y - 0.45, ymax = y + 0.45,
                fill = Matriculation),
            show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 0, y = y, label = paste0(Matriculation, "\n", Totals)),
            size = 3, color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Referrals Dismissed" = "#000000",
                               "Found Eligible" = "#252561",
                               "Engaged" = "#4c68b5",
                               "Admitted" = "#9ab9cd")) + 
  theme_void()

ere_matriculation_funnel_table <- ere_matriculation |> 
  select(Eligible = `% Eligible`, Engaged = `% Engaged`, Admitted = `% Admitted`) |> 
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Referral", values_to = "Actual") |> 
  mutate(Goal = case_when(Referral == "Engaged" ~ "70%", Referral == "Admitted" ~ "60%", TRUE ~ "")) |> 
  select(Referral, Goal, Actual)

ere_funnel_table_colnames <- c(cell_spec("Referrals", color = "white", background = "#000000"), 
                 "Goal", "Actual")

ere_matriculation_funnel_kable <- ere_matriculation_funnel_table |> 
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    align = c("c","c","c"),
    col.names = ere_funnel_table_colnames,
    escape = FALSE
  ) |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),
    font_size = 11
  ) |>
  kableExtra::row_spec(
    0:3,
    color = "black",
    background = "white"
  ) |>
  kableExtra::column_spec(
    1,
    color = "white",
    background = c("#252561","#4c68b5","#9ab9cd")
  )

```

```{r}
#| label: needs-setup


## potential cases where a need may need to be identified focused on those: eligible, able to be contacted post-referral, not a reconnect or transfer to compass, not a re-referral, and the ihna form is completed.
## administrative dismissals have been left in. program management believes this option is really for cases where the client is transferred to a new program (EPICC, BCR, etc.) and noting those needs are important in these scenarios.

## select all needs columns of interest first.
ere_needs <- ere_dismissed |>
  filter(ref_client_eligible == "Yes" 
     & (!dismissal_reason_description %in% c("Reconnect","Re-Referred","Transfer To Compass","Unable To Make Contact Post-Referral"))
     & (enrollment_starting_date != enrollment_ending_date)
     & !is.na(ihna_docserno)
     ) |>
  # filter(
  #   !is.na(
  #     youth_needs
  #   )
  # ) |>
  select(
    client_number,
    enrollment_starting_date,
    enrollment_ending_date,
    dismissal_reason_description,
    agency_description,
    ref_docserno,
    client_needs_docserno,
    client_needs_client_needs,                
    client_needs_basic_needs_referred_engaged,                 
    client_needs_basic_needs_status_three_month,                
    client_needs_basic_needs_status_six_month,                 
    client_needs_birth_certificate_referred_engaged,            
    client_needs_birth_certificate_status_three_month,         
    client_needs_birth_certificate_status_six_month,            
    client_needs_child_care_referred_engaged,              
    client_needs_child_care_status_three_month,                 
    client_needs_child_care_status_six_month,                   
    client_needs_community_based_assist_referred_engaged,     
    client_needs_community_based_assist_status_three_month,    
    client_needs_community_based_assist_status_six_month,       
    client_needs_crisis_services_referred_engaged,          
    client_needs_crisis_services_status_three_month,          
    client_needs_crisis_services_status_six_month,            
    client_needs_dental_care_referred_engaged,                
    client_needs_dental_care_status_three_month,                
    client_needs_dental_care_status_six_month,                 
    client_needs_need_developmental_disabilities_services,      
    client_needs_dd_services_referred_engaged,                  
    client_needs_dd_services_status_three_month,               
    client_needs_dd_services_status_six_month,

    client_needs_employment_services_status_three_month,        
    client_needs_employment_services_status_six_month,          
    client_needs_food_assist_referred_engaged,                  
    client_needs_food_assist_status_three_month,                
    client_needs_food_assist_status_six_month,

    client_needs_housing_status_six_month,

    client_needs_legal_assit_status_six_month,                 
    client_needs_mh_status_referred_engaged,    # mh_referred_engaged,
    client_needs_mh_status_three_month,                         
    client_needs_mh_status_six_month,                         
    client_needs_payor_source_referred_engaged,                
    client_needs_payor_source_status_three_month,               
    client_needs_payor_source_status_six_month,                
    client_needs_phys_health_referred_engaged,                  
    client_needs_phys_health_status_three_month,                
    client_needs_phys_health_status_six_month,                 
    client_needs_psychiatry_referred_engaged,                  
    client_needs_psychiatry_status_three_month,                
    client_needs_psychiatry_status_six_month,                   
    client_needs_ss_card_referred_engaged,                      
    client_needs_ss_card_status_three_month,                    
    client_needs_ss_card_status_six_month,                     
    client_needs_su_services_referred_engaged,                 
    client_needs_su_services_three_month,    # su_services_status_three_month, 
    client_needs_su_services_six_month,      # su_services_status_six_month, 
    client_needs_transportation_assist_referred_engaged,       
    client_needs_transportation_assist_status_three_month,      
    client_needs_transportation_assist_status_six_month,       
    client_needs_medication_assist_referred_engaged,            
    client_needs_medication_assist_status_three_month,          
    client_needs_medication_assist_status_six_month
  ) 

ere_needs_longer <- ere_needs |> 
  select(client_number) |> 
  distinct() |> 
  left_join(ere_needs |>
              pivot_longer(
                cols = c(
                  client_needs_basic_needs_referred_engaged,                 
                  client_needs_basic_needs_status_three_month,                
                  client_needs_basic_needs_status_six_month,                 
                  client_needs_birth_certificate_referred_engaged,            
                  client_needs_birth_certificate_status_three_month,         
                  client_needs_birth_certificate_status_six_month,            
                  client_needs_child_care_referred_engaged,              
                  client_needs_child_care_status_three_month,                 
                  client_needs_child_care_status_six_month,                   
                  client_needs_community_based_assist_referred_engaged,     
                  client_needs_community_based_assist_status_three_month,    
                  client_needs_community_based_assist_status_six_month,       
                  client_needs_crisis_services_referred_engaged,          
                  client_needs_crisis_services_status_three_month,          
                  client_needs_crisis_services_status_six_month,            
                  client_needs_dental_care_referred_engaged,                
                  client_needs_dental_care_status_three_month,                
                  client_needs_dental_care_status_six_month,                 
                  client_needs_need_developmental_disabilities_services,      
                  client_needs_dd_services_referred_engaged,                  
                  client_needs_dd_services_status_three_month,               
                  client_needs_dd_services_status_six_month,                
                  client_needs_employment_services_referred_engaged,          
                  client_needs_employment_services_status_three_month,        
                  client_needs_employment_services_status_six_month,          
                  client_needs_food_assist_referred_engaged,                  
                  client_needs_food_assist_status_three_month,                
                  client_needs_food_assist_status_six_month,                 
                  client_needs_housing_referred_engaged,                      
                  client_needs_housing_status_three_month,                    
                  client_needs_housing_status_six_month,                      
                  client_needs_id_referred_engaged,                           
                  client_needs_id_status_three_month,                         
                  client_needs_id_status_six_month,                          
                  client_needs_legal_assit_referred_enaged, # legal_assit_referred_engaged            
                  client_needs_legal_assit_status_three_month,                
                  client_needs_legal_assit_status_six_month,                 
                  client_needs_mh_status_referred_engaged,  # mh_referred_engaged, 
                  client_needs_mh_status_three_month,                         
                  client_needs_mh_status_six_month,                         
                  client_needs_payor_source_referred_engaged,                
                  client_needs_payor_source_status_three_month,               
                  client_needs_payor_source_status_six_month,                
                  client_needs_phys_health_referred_engaged,                  
                  client_needs_phys_health_status_three_month,                
                  client_needs_phys_health_status_six_month,                 
                  client_needs_psychiatry_referred_engaged,                  
                  client_needs_psychiatry_status_three_month,                
                  client_needs_psychiatry_status_six_month,                   
                  client_needs_ss_card_referred_engaged,                      
                  client_needs_ss_card_status_three_month,                    
                  client_needs_ss_card_status_six_month,                     
                  client_needs_su_services_referred_engaged,                 
                  client_needs_su_services_three_month,  # su_services_status_three_month,                 
                  client_needs_su_services_six_month,    # su_services_status_six_month,                      
                  client_needs_transportation_assist_referred_engaged,       
                  client_needs_transportation_assist_status_three_month,      
                  client_needs_transportation_assist_status_six_month,       
                  client_needs_medication_assist_referred_engaged,            
                  client_needs_medication_assist_status_three_month,          
                  client_needs_medication_assist_status_six_month
                  ),
                names_to = "ere_client_needs_status",
                values_to = "value"
                ) |>
              mutate(
                value_num = case_when(
                  value == "ON" ~ 1,
                  TRUE ~ NA_real_   # catches blanks, missing, unexpected values
                  )
                ) |>
              filter(!is.na(value_num)) |> 
              group_by(client_number) |> 
              summarise(value_num = sum(value_num),
                        .groups = "drop")
            , by = c('client_number')
            ) |> 
  left_join(ere_needs |>
              filter(!is.na(client_needs_client_needs)) |> 
              mutate(needs_identified = TRUE) |> 
              select(client_number, needs_identified) |> 
              distinct()
            , by = c('client_number')
            ) |> 
  mutate(needs_identified = ifelse(is.na(needs_identified), FALSE, needs_identified),
         needs = case_when((is.na(value_num) & needs_identified == FALSE) ~ "No Need Identified"
                           , (is.na(value_num) & needs_identified == TRUE) ~ "Need Identified, Not Addressed"
                           , value_num > 0 ~ "Need Identified, Addressed"
                           , TRUE ~ NA)
  ) |> 
  left_join(ere_needs |> 
              arrange(client_number, desc(enrollment_starting_date)) |> 
              group_by(client_number) |> 
              mutate(rank = dense_rank(desc(enrollment_starting_date))) |> 
              ungroup() |> 
              filter(rank == 1) |> 
              select(client_number, agency_description) |> 
              distinct()
            , by = c('client_number')
            )

```


```{r}
#| label: needs-fy-totals

ere_needs_table <- ere_needs_longer |> 
  mutate(needs_goal = case_when(needs %in% c("Need Identified, Addressed", "Need Identified, Not Addressed") ~ "Identified"
                                , needs == "No Need Identified" ~ "Not Identified"
                                , TRUE ~ NA)
         ) |> 
  summarise(identified = sum(if_else(needs_goal == "Identified", 1, 0)),
            client_totals = n(),
            addressed = sum(if_else(needs == "Need Identified, Addressed", 1, 0)),
            .groups = "drop") |> 
  mutate(goal = 0.6,
         percentage = addressed / identified,
         symbol = case_when(percentage >= 0.6 ~ "✅"
                              , percentage < 0.6 ~ "✖️"
                              , TRUE ~ NA)
         ) |> 
  relocate(client_totals) |> 
  rename(`IA Client Totals` = client_totals,
         `1 ≥ Client Need Identified` = identified,
         `1 ≥ Client Need Met` = addressed,
         Percentage = percentage
         ) |> 
  adorn_pct_formatting(
    columns = c(goal, Percentage),
    digits = 0
    ) |> 
  mutate(Percentage = paste0(Percentage, " ", symbol)) |> 
  select(-symbol)

ere_needs_kable <- ere_needs_table |> 
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    align = c("c","c","c","c"),
    col.names = c(paste0("Engaged",footnote_marker_symbol(1)),
                  "1 ≥ Need Identified",
                  "1 ≥ Need Met",
                  "Goal",
                  "Percent"
                  ),
    escape = FALSE
    # ,caption = ""
  ) |>
  # footnote(symbol = "There is also a filter on dismissals where 'Unable To Locate/Make Contact Post-Referral'.") |>
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),
    font_size = 11
  ) |>
  kableExtra::row_spec(
    0,
    color = "black",
    background = "#88CCEE"
  ) |>
  column_spec(1, width = "1.0cm") |>
  column_spec(2, width = "1.5cm") |>
  column_spec(3, width = "1.8cm") |>
  column_spec(4, width = "0.5cm") |>
  column_spec(5, width = "1.5cm")
```

```{r}
ere_hosp_visit_ed <- ere_dismissed |> 
  mutate(hosp_visit_type = 'ED Response During Business Hours‡') |> 
  group_by(hosp_visit_type) |> 
  summarise(hospital_visit_opportunity = sum(ifelse(matriculation_hospital_visit_opportunity_ed == TRUE
                                                 , 1, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
            hospital_visit_yes = sum(ifelse(matriculation_hospital_visit_ed == TRUE
                                                 , 1, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") 

ere_hosp_visit_inpatient <- ere_dismissed |> 
  mutate(hosp_visit_type = 'Inpatient Response') |> 
  group_by(hosp_visit_type) |> 
  summarise(hospital_visit_opportunity = sum(ifelse(matriculation_hospital_visit_opportunity_inpatient == TRUE
                                                      , 1, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
            hospital_visit_yes = sum(ifelse(matriculation_hospital_visit_inpatient == TRUE
                                                      , 1, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") 

ere_hosp_visit <- ere_hosp_visit_ed |> 
  rbind(ere_hosp_visit_inpatient) |> 
  mutate(goal = case_when(hosp_visit_type == 'ED Response During Business Hours‡' ~ 0.5,
                            hosp_visit_type == 'Inpatient Response' ~ 0.7,
                            TRUE ~ NA),
         percentage = case_when(is.na(hospital_visit_yes) & is.na(hospital_visit_opportunity) ~ NA
                                ,is.na(hospital_visit_yes) ~ 0 
                                , TRUE ~ hospital_visit_yes / hospital_visit_opportunity),
         symbol = case_when(hosp_visit_type == 'ED Response During Business Hours‡' & percentage >= 0.5 ~ "✅" ,
                            hosp_visit_type == 'ED Response During Business Hours‡' & percentage < 0.5 ~ "✖️" ,
                            hosp_visit_type == 'Inpatient Response' & percentage >= 0.7 ~ "✅" ,
                            hosp_visit_type == 'Inpatient Response' & percentage < 0.7 ~ "✖️" ,
                            TRUE ~ NA)
         ) |> 
  adorn_pct_formatting(
    columns = c(goal, percentage),
    digits = 0
    ) |> 
  mutate(percentage = paste0(percentage, " ", symbol)) |> 
  select(-symbol)

ere_hosp_visit_kable <- ere_hosp_visit |> 
  knitr::kable(
    format = "html",
    align = c("l","c","c","c"),
    col.names = c(paste0("Referral Source",footnote_marker_symbol(1)),
                  paste0("Opportunities",footnote_marker_symbol(2)),
                  "Visits",
                  "Goal",
                  "Percent"
                  ),
    escape = FALSE
    # ,caption = ""
  ) |> 
  kableExtra::kable_styling(
    full_width = FALSE,
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"),
    font_size = 11
  ) |> 
  # footnote(symbol = c("Not all referrals are included in the sources noted"
  #   ,"A Hospital Visit Opportunity is a referral that: 1. does NOT have an open an active episode of care (is a re-referral) 2. is NOT a Reconnect or Transfer To Compass"
  #   , "Business Hours are 8am to 4pm")
  # ) |> 
  kableExtra::row_spec(
    0,
    color = "black",
    background = "#88CCEE"
  ) |> 
  kableExtra::column_spec(
    1,
    color = "black",
    bold = TRUE
  ) |>
  column_spec(1, width = "3.5cm") |>
  column_spec(2, width = "1.5cm") |>
  column_spec(3, width = "0.7cm") |>
  column_spec(4, width = "0.5cm") |>
  column_spec(5, width = "1.5cm")

```
